retrieval_scope: local hybrid retrieval: Chroma vector + BM25 + RRF; one original question per call; no web, query expansion, LLM reranker, or context selector

ground_truth_judging.candidate_discovery: BGE embedding similarity against evidence phrases, using the configured Chroma collection embedding function

answer_generation.provider: Groq API using the configured GROQ_MODEL; same model judges chunks and answers
answer_generation.context: Top 5 chunks returned by the existing LocalRetriever
answer_generation.interpretation: LLM judge grade 0-3; normalized score is grade/3. Embedding cosine similarity is a separate semantic diagnostic.

metric_definitions.precision_at_k: Relevant retrieved chunks in top K divided by K.
metric_definitions.recall_at_k: Relevant retrieved chunks in top K divided by all LLM-judged relevant chunks for that question.
metric_definitions.mrr: Mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant chunk, measured through rank 10 (MRR@10).
metric_definitions.ndcg_at_k: Graded nDCG with gain 2^relevance_grade - 1; accepted grades 1, 2, 3 are used. Unjudged chunks receive grade 0.
metric_definitions.binary_relevance_threshold: Grades 2 and 3 count as relevant for Precision, Recall, and MRR. Grade 1 is weakly related and only contributes to graded nDCG.
metric_definitions.aggregation: Macro-average across questions with at least one LLM-judged grade-2-or-3 chunk in the evidence-phrase candidate pool.
